verdict.rationale: Docs show a simple getSandbox()/API call model to obtain an isolated VM-based sandbox with immediate exec/file/session capabilities, matching the one-call provisioning story. However, community evidence disputes 'seconds' latency claims, citing 1-5s boot times (slower than competing Firecracker setups at 20-50ms) and no built-in idle-timeout/auto-destroy, indicating real-world caveats to the lifecycle experience.
